acceptance_gates.principle: Capstones reflect reality; they do not gate. The deliverable is validity of the schema, not a numeric threshold.

field_principles.best_247_auroc: Carry-forward or improved headline AUROC. Carry-forward 0.9857 if ensemble v9 regressed, was adversarially flagged, or didn't run. Only update if exp2579.ensemble_v9_viable=True AND no regression detected.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall-clock measurement for the capstone synthesis itself.
field_principles.external_baselines: HIVE peer (0.9236, arXiv:2604.26139) and HalluScan peer (0.67 mean, arXiv:2605.02443) carried forward for continuous gap tracking.
field_principles.gatemate_status: Hardware continuity tracking per CLAUDE.md Hardware-Task Continuity Discipline. Reflects exp2577 outcome (terminal / manual_repair_attempted / jtag_not_detected); carries forward .246 terminal state if exp2577 did not run.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefix required. Must start with complete:.
field_principles.ipfs_mirror_status: Rule 3 (mandatory mirroring) compliance tracking. 'pinned_cid_known' iff exp2571.ipfs_cid IS NOT NULL; 'documented_operator_needed' otherwise.
field_principles.jepa_online_active: FR-11 Tier 3 mandate deliverable -- continuous self-learning active? True iff exp2576.jepa_online_learning_active=True.
field_principles.kv260_status: Hardware continuity tracking per CLAUDE.md Hardware-Task Continuity Discipline. Reflects exp2578 outcome (sd_flashed / sd_absent_prep_updated); carries forward .246 non-terminal state if exp2578 did not run.
field_principles.n_experiments_completed: Count of exp2569-exp2579 artifacts whose honest_verdict starts with a terminal prefix (complete:/success:/passed:/shipped:). Blocked verdicts do NOT count.
field_principles.operator_recommendation: submit_arxiv_now / update_hf_cards_push_ipfs / continue_safety_classifier / hardware_terminal_pending / all_tracks_advancing. Drives the operator's next action; honesty about ambiguity matters.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records which source artifacts were present and read.
field_principles.process_flags: Any non-terminal honesty signals collected from the source artifacts -- fabrication flags, malformed verdict prefixes, blocked-precondition tasks, execution-layer gaps when too many planned tasks produced no artifact.
field_principles.random_seed: 42 -- synthesis is deterministic but the field is convention.
field_principles.safety_classifier_viable: Tier B product milestone deliverable -- is the safety classifier viable? True iff exp2574.safety_verifier_viable=True AND exp2575.safety_integration_complete=True. Both gates must hold; the field is read from artifacts, never inferred from sibling state.
field_principles.tier0s_real_improvement: Documents whether the real-corpus verifier gap narrowed for tier0s. True iff exp2572.tier0s_improved=True.
field_principles.tier0u_real_improvement: Documents whether the real-corpus verifier gap narrowed for tier0u. True iff exp2573.tier0u_improved=True.
field_principles.top_3_gaps_for_248: Three most critical unresolved issues entering .248.
field_principles.top_3_successes: Three most impactful positive findings of .247.

top_3_successes.summary: Ensemble v9 improved over the .245 v7b 0.9857 cite-safe baseline with adversarial-clean seeds; real-corpus-validated tier0s/tier0u substitutions paid off in the headline AUROC.

Both tier0s and tier0u verifiers retrained on real FoVer corpus cleared the viability gate. The real-corpus AUROC gap that drove the .246 paper errata is closed; the ensemble no longer wastes calibration signal on near-random verifiers.

Tier B safety/jailbreak classifier viable: Ising safety verifier implemented on a 200-pair safe/unsafe corpus and integrated into the ensemble pipeline. First commercially viable product surface outside hallucination verification.
